items.source: Each path will be interpreted as a Spring Resource. A plain path — for example, "schema.sql" — will be treated as a classpath resource that is relative to the package in which the test class is defined. A path starting with a slash will be treated as an absolute classpath resource, for example: "/org/example/schema.sql". A path which references a URL (for example, a path prefixed with classpath:, file:, http:, etc.) will be loaded using the specified resource protocol.
items.translation: 每个路径都将被解释为 Spring Resource。普通路径——例如，"schema.sql"——将被视为相对于测试类所在包中的 classpath 资源。以斜杠开头的路径将被视为绝对 classpath 资源，例如："/org/example/schema.sql"。引用 URL 的路径（例如，以前缀为 classpath:、file:、http: 等开头的路径）将使用指定的资源协议加载。

items.source: The configuration options provided by this annotation and @SqlConfig are equivalent to those supported by ScriptUtils and ResourceDatabasePopulator but are a superset of those provided by the <jdbc:initialize-database/> XML namespace element. Consult the javadocs of individual attributes in this annotation and @SqlConfig for details.
items.translation: 此注解提供的配置选项与@SqlConfig支持的选项等效，且是<jdbc:initialize-database/>XML 命名空间元素所提供选项的超集。这些选项与ScriptUtils和ResourceDatabasePopulator支持的选项等效。有关详细信息，请参阅此注解及@SqlConfig中各个属性的 Javadoc。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with value(), but it may be used instead of value(). Similarly, this attribute may be used in conjunction with or instead of statements().
items.translation: 此属性不能与value()一起使用，但可以作为value()的替代方案。同样，此属性也可以与statements()一起使用或作为其替代方案。

items.source: Method-level declarations override class-level declarations by default, but this behavior can be configured via @SqlMergeMode. However, this does not apply to class-level declarations configured for the BEFORE_TEST_CLASS or AFTER_TEST_CLASS execution phase. Such declarations cannot be overridden, and the corresponding scripts and statements will be executed once per class in addition to any method-level scripts and statements.
items.translation: 方法级别的声明默认会覆盖类级别的声明，但此行为可以通过 @SqlMergeMode 进行配置。然而，这不适用于为 BEFORE_TEST_CLASS 或 AFTER_TEST_CLASS 执行阶段配置的类级别声明。此类声明无法被覆盖，相应的脚本和语句将在每个类中执行一次，此外还会执行任何方法级别的脚本和语句。

items.source: @Sql can be used as a repeatable annotation. Otherwise, @SqlGroup can be used as an explicit container for declaring multiple instances of @Sql.
items.translation: @Sql 可以作为可重复注解使用。否则，可以使用@SqlGroup作为显式容器来声明多个@Sql实例。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with scripts(), but it may be used instead of scripts().
items.translation: 此属性不能与scripts()一起使用，但可以作为scripts()的替代方案。

items.source: If no SQL scripts or statements() are specified, an attempt will be made to detect a default script depending on where this annotation is declared. If a default cannot be detected, an IllegalStateException will be thrown.
items.translation: 如果未指定 SQL 脚本或 `statements()`，将尝试根据此注解的声明位置检测一个默认脚本。如果无法检测到默认脚本，将抛出IllegalStateException。

items.source: This annotation will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details. This annotation may also be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations with attribute overrides.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此注解将从外部测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅@NestedTestConfiguration。此注解还可用作元注解，以创建具有属性覆盖的自定义组合注解。

items.source: If you want to see which SQL scripts are being executed, set the org.springframework.test.context.jdbc logging category to DEBUG. If you want to see which SQL statements are being executed, set the org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.init logging category to DEBUG.
items.translation: 如果您想查看正在执行的 SQL 脚本，请将`org.springframework.test.context.jdbc`日志类别设置为`DEBUG`。如果您想查看正在执行的 SQL 语句，请将`org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.init`日志类别设置为`DEBUG`。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.2, paths may contain property placeholders (${...}) that will be replaced by properties stored in the Environment of the test's ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.2 起，路径可以包含属性占位符（${...}），这些占位符将被测试的 ApplicationContext 中的 Environment 存储的属性替换。

items.source: Statements declared via this attribute will be executed after statements loaded from resource scripts(). If you wish to have inlined statements executed before scripts, simply declare multiple instances of @Sql on the same class or method.
items.translation: 通过此属性声明的语句将在从资源加载的scripts()语句之后执行。如果您希望内联语句在脚本之前执行，只需在同一类或方法上声明多个@Sql实例即可。

items.source: Script execution is performed by the SqlScriptsTestExecutionListener, which is enabled by default.
items.translation: 脚本执行由SqlScriptsTestExecutionListener完成，该组件默认已启用。

items.source: Use of this annotation requires the spring-jdbc and spring-tx modules as well as their transitive dependencies to be present on the classpath.
items.translation: 使用此注解需要 `spring-jdbc` 和 `spring-tx` 模块及其传递依赖存在于类路径中。

items.source: This attribute may be used in conjunction with or instead of scripts().
items.translation: 此属性可与 scripts() 配合使用，或替代其使用。

items.source: Defaults to BEFORE_TEST_METHOD.
items.translation: 默认为BEFORE_TEST_METHOD。

items.source: See the class-level javadocs for SqlConfig for explanations of local vs. global configuration, inheritance, overrides, etc.
items.translation: 有关本地与全局配置、继承、覆盖等的说明，请参阅 SqlConfig 的类级别 Javadoc。

items.source: Defaults to an empty @SqlConfig instance.
items.translation: 默认为一个空的@SqlConfig实例。

items.source: Alias for scripts().
items.translation: ``scripts() 的别名。

items.source: method-level declaration: if the annotated test method is named testMethod() and is defined in the class com.example.MyTest, the corresponding default script is "classpath:com/example/MyTest.testMethod.sql".
items.translation: 方法级声明：如果标注的测试方法名为 testMethod() 且定义在类 com.example.MyTest 中，则对应的默认脚本为 "classpath:com/example/MyTest.testMethod.sql"。

items.source: class-level declaration: if the annotated test class is com.example.MyTest, the corresponding default script is "classpath:com/example/MyTest.sql".
items.translation: 类级别声明：如果标注的测试类是 com.example.MyTest，则对应的默认脚本为 "classpath:com/example/MyTest.sql"。

items.source: Default Script Detection
items.translation: 默认脚本检测

items.source: Enumeration of phases that dictate when SQL scripts are executed.
items.translation: 枚举阶段，这些阶段决定了何时执行 SQL 脚本。

items.source: Local configuration for the SQL scripts and statements declared within this @Sql annotation.
items.translation: 此@Sql注解中声明的SQL脚本和语句的本地配置。

items.source: Inlined SQL statements to execute.
items.translation: 内联的 SQL 语句 用于执行。

items.source: When the SQL scripts and statements should be executed.
items.translation: 何时应执行 SQL 脚本和语句。

items.source: The paths to the SQL scripts to execute.
items.translation: 要执行的 SQL 脚本路径。
